raw_request_summary: Process the recommended sequence and create the missing holistic Code-Factory workflow/skill review plan.

work_items.scope_summary: Audit the full Code-Factory workflow and all source skills, consolidate prior findings, and govern their remediation as independently approved child work items.
work_items.primary_outcome: One canonical, evidence-backed portfolio states what is closed, open, stale or unverified and sequences the remaining work without bypassing human gates.
in_scope: 42 source skills and their contracts, boundaries, schemas, references, language and runtime discoverability
The s01-s08 workflow, policy, templates, validators, receipts and protocol
Runtime mirrors, adapters, hooks, MCP, CI/release and portfolio-state integrity
Prior plans and findings with ownership, priority, dependencies, gates and verification paths
out_of_scope: Bulk-fixing child findings inside the portfolio research item
Using portfolio approval as child-work-item approval
Self-approving human-controlled gates or rewriting immutable release evidence
